in_marathi.name: Govardhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Protector of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Govardhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Govardhan is a name derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Govardhana’, which means ‘governing all’. In Hindu mythology, Lord Krishna, who is often depicted as Govardhan, is believed to have lifted the hill Govardhana to protect the people of Vrindavan from Indra's wrath. Thus, Govardhan is a name symbolizing protection and governance.
